Name: Only When It Counts - No More Wasted Stamina
Author: Trapyy
Description:
[size=5][b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Trapyy/mods]My Other Mods[/url][/b][/size]
If you like the mod and want to help me, you can do so in my [color=#ff7700][url=http://ko-fi.com/trapyy]Ko-Fi[/url][/color]

[size=6][b]Overview[/b][/size]
OnlyWhenItCounts is a Stardew Valley mod designed to make your farming life a little less tiring by preventing stamina loss when your tool swings don't accomplish any work. Swing your axe or pickaxe with confidence, knowing you'll only spend energy when you're actually hitting a tree or a rock!
For example, if you swing your axe but miss the tree, or water an already watered tile, your stamina will be preserved. Spend less time worrying about wasted energy and more time getting things done!

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]Stamina Preservation:[/b] Automatically detects if your tool use (Axe, Pickaxe, Hoe, Watering Can, Fishing Rod) would have an effect. If not, your stamina is instantly restored.
[/list]
[size=5][b]How to Use[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*] [b]Install SMAPI:[/b] Ensure you have the latest version of SMAPI installed.
[*] [b]Install Generic Mod Config Menu (Recommended):[/b] For easy in-game configuration.
[*] [b]Download OnlyWhenItCounts:[/b] Get the latest version from the Files tab.
[*] [b]Install OnlyWhenItCounts:[/b] Unzip the download and place the [font=Courier New]OnlyWhenItCounts[/font] folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] directory.
[*] [b]Launch the Game:[/b] Run Stardew Valley via SMAPI.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Accessing Configuration:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]With GMCM:[/b] Click the gear icon on the title screen or find the settings button in the in-game options menu. Look for "OnlyWhenItCounts".
[*] [b]Without GMCM:[/b] Edit the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file located in [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods/OnlyWhenItCounts[/font] after running the game once with the mod.
[/list][/list]

[size=5][b]Mod Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM):[/b] Fully supported for easy in-game configuration.
[*] [b]Item Extensions:[/b] It works with any nodes and clumps from Item Extensions.
[/list]
